- Technical architecture review (60m): discuss network connectivity (VPC peering / Transit Gateway), KMS/HSM integration, and on-prem hosting constraints.
- Security evidence & compliance: we'll pull together SOC 2 summary and audit logs notes for your security team.

Proposed next step: schedule the architecture review with your cloud/infra and security leads. I can bring Marissa (solutions engineer) for the deep-dive and Nikhil (security lead) for KMS/audit discussion. Suggested windows next week (PST):

- Tue 11/28 10:00–11:00
- Wed 11/29 14:00–15:00

If those don't work, drop 2–3 times that do and I'll send a calendar invite. Attached are the discovery notes and a short private deployment overview as pre-read.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
